| [0011](./0011/) | cli | accepted | minor | in-progress | 2026-08-16 — cli-catalog-gates IMPLEMENTED and moved to done — D22's two structural gates and D9's compatibility gate are live on `opm catalog publish`, and D7's `opm catalog registry check [--compat]` exists under the new `catalog registry` subgroup. The member walk is filesystem-driven per 0010 D49 (<kind>/<apiVersion> packages plus flat transformers; a value walk reaches about half the contract members and no blueprints), every member unifies against #CatalogMemberFQNGate and every trait's optional FIELD against #TraitOptionalGate under CONCRETE evaluation without the pipeline's incomplete-filter — the measured blind spots (missing declaredAPIVersion, unstated posture) ARE the finding — and CUE's error is refusal 11, never hand-written. The pre-D49 refusal-11 sketch in 06-operational (bare kindPrefix[kind] equality) is SUPERSEDED by the shipped gate's derived filing segment — moot in practice, the message is CUE's. The alpha carve-out is compat-only: real-tree smoke against catalog_opm/src and the live GHCR history gates all 120 members and 27 trait postures clean and compares all 66 beta/GA members clean. Predecessor selection implements D9's literal rule per D23, appended this landing (Amends D9): backward scan strictly below the effective version, same major, PRERELEASES INCLUDED, newest first; remove-then-readd refused against the older build; apiVersion bump passes as new; a package absent at a version is the scan's negative signal while any transport failure aborts with no partial verdict (the plan renders INCOMPLETE — the connectivity contract extends over the whole walk, and the pipeline's one-round-trip comment is rewritten to name it). registry check pulls by path@version through CUE's own module cache, runs the consumer's materialize-time identity twin over the pulled catalog's metadata (never its identity package), reports the member inventory per kind/apiVersion, and --compat reruns the same walk over the fetched build — proven against a build pushed AROUND the gates via raw modzip, the exact artifact class D7 exists for. Help text carries D35's aid-not-guarantee framing verbatim (graduation-gated, constructor- and e2e-pinned); exit 0 clean / 2 findings / 3 unreachable. TWO MEASURED COMPARATOR FACTS FORCED A DEVIATION in how 0010 D30's exemption is applied, both invisible to hermetic fixtures and surfaced only by the real tree: (1) StripProvenance's InlineImports round-trip cannot rebuild a core-typed member — the emitted syntax references core's hidden #KebabToPascal helper (reached via metadata.#definitionName) without inlining it, and every real member is core-typed; (2) the walk's leaf subsume false-positives on BYTE-IDENTICAL schemas carrying matchN validators or pending comprehensions (#Image's if-guards) — measured, 33 of 66 unchanged members reported domain narrowed. The gate therefore applies the D30 denylist as a violation-path filter at the same scope (metadata.catalogVersion, metadata.description — direct children only) and short-circuits members whose emitted syntax is identical modulo provenance, a correct rule in its own right: a member restamped by a release cannot have changed shape. The walk runs only over members that actually changed; its residual matchN/comprehension noise on those is a recorded library limitation, carried into the library follow-up beside the catalog-compatibility spec's Predecessor Selection re-scope (HighestStable stays — cli-template-modules is its first true caller as template resolution's version selector). ALSO RECORDED: no `opm catalog vet` is built — nothing in this entry backs it, `publish --dry-run` and `registry check` cover both directions; the D49-opacity bound (pre-D49 -0.dev builds are opaque to the scan's filing-convention probe — acceptable, that horizon is entirely alpha-era) is documented in the real-tree test; and OQ10 opens the gap the walk cannot see — removal of a beta+ member is refused by nothing. | [0015](./0015/) | cross-cutting | draft | - | not-started | 2026-08-05 — Drafted from a design conversation grounded in three measurements taken the same day. `core/src/catalog.cue` carries exactly ONE member map, `#transformers`, and `library/opm/materialize/index.go:39-41` skips any catalog build without one — so a contract with no adapter is absent from the materialized world, which is precisely the state 0010 D37's `fulfilment: "provider"` creates on purpose. `compile/match.go:344-360` is SUBSET containment, not equality, so a more-specific transformer never displaces a less-specific one; both pair and both render, and 0010 D32's guard does not reach the case because it fires only for `fulfilment: "provider"` contracts. And the real discriminator across the 8 transformers sharing `catalog_opm`'s `#ContainerResource` bucket is `requiredLabels` (`daemonset_transformer.cue:27-29`), not the resource/trait set — which is what makes 0010 D36's `matchLabels` the lever for provider classes rather than a new matcher concept. Four decisions locked: D1 (explicit contract maps), D2 (classes, amending 0010 D37), D3 (RBAC-gated registration CR), D4 (no contract/adapter packaging split, decided now because riding 0010's FQN break is nearly free and a standalone break later is not). Six Open Questions carried. | Catalog Contracts, Provider Classes, and Transformer Registration |
| [0016](./0016/) | cli | draft | - | not-started | 2026-08-13 — Drafted. Nothing turns a published module into the on-disk instance package everything downstream consumes (opm instance build/apply, the operator's ModulePackage path): `opm module init` scaffolds author-side modules, and library synth.Instance builds instances only in memory — explicitly refusing a debugValues fallback as "a frontend policy concern". Three decisions came from the user on the day: a new CLI command scaffolds a standalone instance package from an OCI module reference and tag (D1); the generated values.cue defaults to the module's debugValues, making init useful against the already-published fleet with no republish (D2); and #Module gains an optional field (working name initValues) carrying the author-intended init template, taking precedence over debugValues, whose testing contract stays unchanged (D3). Six Open Questions carried: field name/shape and #config conformance (OQ1), command surface and ref syntax (OQ2), empty-source behavior (OQ3), renderer home library-vs-cli (OQ4), init-time validation (OQ5), generated cue.mod pinning strategy (OQ6). | Initialize a Module Instance Package from a Published Module |

## Status legend

- **draft** — initial design, actively being written
- **accepted** — design agreed upon, ready for implementation
- **implemented** — design has been realized in code
- **superseded** — replaced by a newer enhancement (see `superseded_by` in the entry's config.yaml)
